related_questions.question: At what age do you stop paying property taxes in Texas?
related_questions.snippet: You are eligible for the over-65 exemption the year that you turn 65. You can apply at any time during that year, but if you file by April 30, the exemption can be processed in time for your property tax bill that year. Otherwise, the exemption will be applied retroactively.

related_questions.question: What is the exemption for over 65 in Rockwall County?
related_questions.snippet: Rockwall County does not offer a percentage-based exemption for ad valorem taxes on residential homesteads. The homestead property tax exemption for people 65 and older is $35,000 (a tax ceiling is applied) and for disabled persons is $0 (but a tax ceiling is applied).
